entities.name: Query ArgJ protein
observations: 303 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 32.5 kDa and pI 6.37.
Contains an ArgJ Pfam domain (PF01960.24) spanning residues 20–288.
Shows 55–58% identity over about 90% of the query to reviewed bacterial ArgJ homologs.
Likely catalyzes N-acetylglutamate synthesis and ornithine-producing transacetylation in cyclic arginine biosynthesis.
Predicted to be cytoplasmic based on strong homology to reviewed ArgJ proteins; sequence lacks an evident signal peptide or transmembrane segment.

entities.name: ArgJ
observations: Bifunctional ornithine acetyltransferase/N-acetylglutamate synthase in the cyclic arginine biosynthetic pathway.
Catalyzes acetyl transfer between glutamate, acetyl-CoA, and N-acetylornithine depending on pathway direction.
Reviewed bacterial homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic proteins involved in arginine and ornithine biosynthesis.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: ArgJ functions at the entry/recycling step of the cyclic arginine biosynthetic route, supplying N-acetylated intermediates and enabling ornithine production.
